findings.title: Hourly total is not protected against unsafe-integer overflow
findings.why: The new overflow guard is only in rentalTotal (daily path). The hourly branch computes hours * hourlyPrice unchecked, and hourlyPrice may be up to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. The result silently loses precision instead of throwing 'rental total is too large'.

findings.title: Overflow guard rejects short stays that never use the discount arithmetic
findings.why: The check on full*9+5 runs for every stay, but the discount only applies from 3 days. A 1- or 2-day rental whose full price is a safe integer but whose full*9+5 is not (for example dailyPrice near MAX_SAFE_INTEGER/2) gets 'too large', although the exact total is representable.
